name: Upgrade a Juniper EVO router
description: Image download, validation and installation with reboot, as a guided procedure. The software, file and request commands are Junos CLI commands sent as RPCs; check them against your devices with Pick from device RPCs before relying on them. Snapshot, drain and undrain are instructions, because they are not controller RPCs.

steps.title: Before you start
steps.text:
Guided upgrade of **{{device}}**.

This guide follows the manual procedure: look at what is installed, get the new image onto the router, validate it, drain the router, install with a reboot, then reconnect and compare.

Steps that change the router are confirmed one by one before they run.

steps.title: Take a snapshot of the router state
steps.question: Take a new snapshot of **{{device}}** now (`show_router_state`), so you can compare after the upgrade. Is it taken, or is the existing one recent enough?

steps.title: Copy the image to the router
Image to use
steps.label: Full path of the image on the router

steps.title: Validation passed
steps.question: Did the validation of `{{image_path}}` succeed? Only continue if it did.

steps.title: Drain the router
steps.question: Is **{{device}}** drained (`drain_router {{device}}`)? Skip draining only if it already is.

steps.title: Version is the expected one
steps.question: Is **{{device}}** running the version you installed (`{{image_path}}`)?

steps.title: After the upgrade
steps.text: Undrain the router (`undrain_router {{device}}`) and compare with the snapshot (`show_router_state {{device}}`).
